seo.title: VicastCam FAQ | Help for Android and iOS
seo.description: Find answers to common questions about VicastCam for Android and iOS, including account setup, media permissions, network connections, and live streaming issues.

hero.description: Choose your platform (Android or iOS) to see common questions and solutions for your device.

questions.title: What are the recommended dimensions for live stream assets?

answer.text: Recommended dimensions for live stream assets:

items: For live stream background images, we recommend 1080 x 1920 pixels; for videos, we also recommend 1080 x 1920 pixels.
Important: Full-screen overlays must use a 9:16 aspect ratio to ensure seamless switching between full-screen and 9:16 modes without misalignment, achieving a perfectly fitted effect.

questions.title: What output modes are supported for streaming?

answer.text: Streaming supports two output modes: 9:16 streaming and full-screen streaming. Follow these steps to select one on your Android device:

items: Open VicastCam, go to the live streaming page, and tap the menu icon on the right side.

answer.alt: Menu entry on the right side of the Android live streaming page
answer.caption: Step 1: Tap the menu icon on the right side of the live streaming page.

items: In More Settings, find 'Aspect Ratio' and choose 'Full Screen' or '9:16' as needed.

answer.alt: Aspect ratio options in More Settings on Android
answer.caption: Step 2: In 'Aspect Ratio', select 'Full Screen' or '9:16'.

answer.text: Explanation of the two modes

items: 9:16 streaming: The output aspect ratio is fixed at 9:16, so the live platform receives a 9:16 image.
Full-screen streaming: Streams the entire phone screen as-is, preserving the native content without cropping.

questions.title: How do I delete my account?

answer.text: Please log in to the VicastCam app, then go to [Account - top-right icon - Account Management - Delete Account - Submit Deletion Request].
Account information

After account deletion, we will permanently delete your linked email, device records, and other identity information, and revoke your third-party login authorization via Google and Apple accounts. After revocation, you will no longer be able to use those third-party accounts for quick login; to use the app again, you will need to re-authorize and re-link.
Content and assets

items: All live stream assets, videos, images, and project files are stored only on your device; the cloud does not retain any creative assets. After deletion, the asset management feature in the app will no longer work, so please back up your assets in advance via 'Asset Export'.
If you uninstall and reinstall, switch devices, or fail to export a backup in advance, your assets will be permanently unrecoverable.

answer.text: Membership benefits

After account deletion, your membership benefits will terminate immediately. If you have an active Google Play subscription, deleting your app account will not automatically cancel the subscription, and you may continue to be charged. Please go to Google Play's 'Payments & subscriptions - Subscriptions' to manually cancel.
If you have any questions, please contact our customer support team.

questions.title: Why can't I access my phone's photos and videos when adding them?

answer.text: If your photo album appears empty when adding assets, you can enable photo access permissions as follows:

items: iOS: Open your phone's Settings, scroll down to find VicastCam, tap [Photos - All Photos] to enable access.
Android: Open your phone's Settings, find VicastCam under [Permission Management] or [App Management], then tap [Permission Management - Photos - All Photos] to enable access.
If the issue persists, try uninstalling and reinstalling the app, or contact online support via the feedback feature.

questions.title: What should I do if the screen is not fully displayed when streaming from a computer?

answer.text: If the screen appears incomplete when streaming from your phone via a live streaming companion app or other software, follow these steps to adjust:

items: Open VicastCam, tap the camera icon at the bottom to enter the live streaming page, then go to [Right-side menu - More Settings - Aspect Ratio - 9:16].
After casting to the live streaming companion, first fit the screen to the canvas, then drag vertically to fill the screen.

answer.text: Note: Before starting your stream, adjust the aspect ratio first, then add your assets.

questions.title: What should I do if a network request fails?

answer.text: If you encounter network request failures, try the following:

items: Open your phone's Settings, go to [Permission Management - VicastCam - Mobile Data and Wi-Fi] and enable network access.
Turn off power-saving mode and any background restrictions on your phone.
Switch networks, restart your phone, toggle airplane mode, or update the app to the latest version.
If the issue persists, take a screenshot of the error and contact customer support for assistance.

questions.title: Why do network assets or overlays flicker or go black during a live stream?

answer.text: If you experience flickering or black screens when adding network assets during a live stream, here's how to handle it:

items: Download and preview any assets or overlays you plan to use during the stream in advance, and confirm they work properly before going live.
Some assets included with the software are stored on servers. If you download them before going live, you can use them directly during the stream without reloading.
Loading assets mid-stream consumes streaming resources, phone memory, and performance, which can cause lag; on lower-end phones, it may even lead to crashes or black screens.

answer.text: Important note
Before going live, plan and rehearse your stream thoroughly to ensure every element works flawlessly before you start.

questions.title: What should I do if some keys on the keyboard are covered?

answer.text: If some keys on the virtual keyboard are covered, try the following:

items: If you're using an older 16:9 phone as the remote, and some keys are covered, tap the second button in the top-left corner of the keyboard to enable full-screen operation mode.
If the keyboard layout is misaligned, go to your phone's Settings and set the font size to normal.
Some phones have an elderly mode enabled; turning it off should restore the keyboard to normal display.

answer.text: Display issues are usually caused by oversized fonts or an oversized phone theme interface. Resetting these to standard mode should resolve the problem.

questions.title: What should I do if my Huawei phone keeps disconnecting from multi-camera or virtual keyboard?

answer.text: If your Huawei phone experiences disconnections with multi-camera or virtual keyboard, follow these steps:

items: Go to your phone's Settings.
In the search bar at the top, type 'App launch management'.
Go to the App launch management page, scroll down to find VicastCam.
Turn off the toggle on the right so the icon turns gray; at the same time, enable all three options in the popup so they turn blue.

answer.text: You can also refer to the video tutorial 'How to prevent disconnections with multi-camera and virtual keyboard on Huawei phones'.

questions.title: What's the difference between System Streaming and Software Streaming?

answer.text: Apple devices offer two streaming capture modes, which differ significantly in background operation rules. Follow these steps to choose a streaming mode:

items: Open VicastCam, go to the live streaming page, and tap the menu icon on the right side.

answer.alt: Menu entry on the right side of the Apple live streaming page
answer.caption: Step 1: Tap the menu icon on the right side of the live streaming page.

items: In More Settings, find 'Streaming Mode' and select 'System Streaming' or 'Software Streaming' as needed.

answer.alt: Streaming mode options in More Settings on Apple
answer.caption: Step 2: In 'Streaming Mode', select 'System Streaming' or 'Software Streaming'.

answer.text: About the two modes

items: System Streaming (ReplayKit screen recording): Uses iOS system screen recording to capture the screen, allowing continuous streaming even when the app is in the background. You can switch to other apps and still capture any screen content without interrupting the stream.

Software Streaming (direct capture in the foreground): The app captures the screen directly. Due to iOS system limitations, the app must remain in the foreground. If you switch to another app or return to the home screen, streaming will stop immediately.
